subject: FW: Truvio purge request - prompt/output/logs deletion & proof
messages:
From: Claire Hopkins <claire@truvio.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Truvio Legal <legal@truvio.com>; ops+truvio@truvio.com
Date: Fri, 21 Mar 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Complete purge of prompts/outputs/logs for Truvio (TV-498)

Hi Aditya —

We need Redwood to execute a full purge of all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and request logs associated with Truvio account TV-498. This includes:
- Prompt-output store (bucket: outputs-prod-03)
- KV cache snapshots tied to customer prefix trv_/ (both in-memory and persisted snapshots)
- Request logs and tracing spans kept in the hosted cluster for the last 720 days (our retention request overrides standard retention)

Please confirm the scope you will act on, an expected completion window, and the type of proof you will provide (manifests, checksums, record counts). Truvio legal would like an auditable artifact we can attach to our compliance folder.

Thanks,
Claire Hopkins
Head of Ops, Truvio
claire@truvio.com

--
Truvio, Inc.
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hopkins <claire@truvio.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Mar 2025 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Complete purge of prompts/outputs/logs for Truvio (TV-498)

Claire —

Thanks for the clear scope. I’ve looped in Marissa, Rishi and Grace from Ops who will own execution and evidence. We’ll run the purge across our hosted runtime and any reserved/dedicated pools where TV-498 has pinned capacity.

Initial plan & timeline:
- Today: Ops will confirm target buckets/keys and open SUP-1242.
- 48–72 hours: Execute deletion jobs and KV cache sweep (two-pass to ensure in-memory flush + persisted artifacts).
- Within 5 business days: Provide a deletion_manifest.csv and audit-log-summary PDF with counts, checksums (SHA256) and references to the runs.

Marissa/Rishi — can you confirm if dedicated/private tenants require a separate handoff and whether we should include a DocuSign attestation for legal? Claire — does Truvio want the manifest pushed to the shared Drive link (preferred) or sent via email?

Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Hopkins <claire@truvio.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Mar 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Complete purge of prompts/outputs/logs for Truvio (TV-498)

All —

Scope confirmation and execution notes from Ops:
- Targets: outputs-prod-03/* (S3), kvstore-01 (persistent snapshots), request-logs-cluster-7 (Elasticsearch indices: trv-requests-*).
- Approach: 1) Quarantine writes to identified prefixes; 2) Two-pass delete: flush KV cache to disk with tombstones, remove persisted snapshots, then delete S3 objects and ES indices; 3) Run a consistency scanner to ensure no remaining keys matching prefix trv_ and run an append-only audit log of actions.
- Evidence artifacts we will produce: kv-targets-list.txt, kvcache-snapshot-20250321.txt (pre-delete inventory), deletion_manifest.csv (rows: object_path, size_bytes, sha256, deletion_timestamp), audit-log-summary-20250321.pdf (counts and operation IDs).

Notes / asks:
- Claire: confirm whether to also scrub prefix-based cache entries on any Dedicated pools (we need explicit opt-in if you want Redwood-managed Dedicated instances wiped; otherwise we will provide manifests for those and coordinate a separate outage window).
- Grace: schedule the quarantine window for 14:00–16:00 PST and run the scanner immediately after deletion.

Attachment: [Attachment: kv-targets-list.txt (TXT, 1.2KB)]

Marissa Cole
Operations Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hopkins <claire@truvio.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Mar 2025 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Complete purge of prompts/outputs/logs for Truvio (TV-498)

Claire / Team —

Work completed and evidence attached. Summary:
- Deletion window executed: 2025-03-24T14:00:00-07:00 -> 2025-03-24T15:37:22-07:00.
- Objects removed: 18,432 S3 objects under outputs-prod-03/trv_*.
- KV snapshots invalidated and removed from kvstore-01: 46 snapshots, total 1.6GB removed.
- ES indices trv-requests-2023, trv-requests-2024 deleted and tombstoned per retention override.

Artifacts (attached):
- deletion_manifest.csv [Attachment: deletion_manifest.csv (CSV, 12KB)]
  - sample row: outputs-prod-03/trv_session_20240203.json, 4023, 9f2a...c4b, 2025-03-24T14:05:12Z
- kvcache-snapshot-20250321.txt [Attachment: kvcache-snapshot-20250321.txt (TXT, 8KB)]
- audit-log-summary-20250321.pdf [Attachment: audit-log-summary-20250321.pdf (PDF, 95KB)]

Checksums and counts were recorded. We executed the consistency scanner after deletion and observed zero remaining keys matching trv_ across the scanned partitions. For Dedicated pools where Truvio has pinned capacity, no deletions were performed without explicit approval; a separate manifest will be generated if you authorize that.

If Truvio requires an executed attestation (DocuSign) we can produce a templated statement and route it to Legal once Claire confirms.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Hopkins <claire@truvio.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.ai>, Truvio Legal <legal@truvio.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Mar 2025 17:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Complete purge of prompts/outputs/logs for Truvio (TV-498)

Claire —

Thanks — please find attached the deletion_manifest.csv and audit summary produced by Ops. Key points:
- All requested artifacts under the hosted tenants have been deleted; KV caches were swept and persisted snapshots removed.
- Dedicated tenants were not modified (no action without your signoff).
- Evidence pushed to shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-erasure-evidence-TRV (we also attached the main artifacts to this thread).

Would you like us to prepare a formal attestation document for Legal (DocuSign) or is the provided manifest sufficient for your compliance folder? Happy to jump on a 15-minute call to walk through the evidence.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
